portfolio_context: Actual holding, tax basis and risk budget were not supplied; no position size or trade authorization is implied.
structural_thesis: XCOPRI has transformed SKBP from cash-burning biotech into a profitable U.S.-direct CNS commercial company. The next question is whether management can build a second durable product before the 2032 compound-patent cliff without destroying incremental ROIC.

structural_change_and_leadership.reason: Profitable U.S.-direct franchise and deliberate second-product/platform strategy; Opakalim remains unclosed and on partial hold.

customer_value_and_product.reason: XCOPRI Q2 U.S. sales +45.6% YoY and prescription momentum; commercial value still almost entirely one molecule.

moat_trajectory.reason: Direct sales, physician relationships and IP are meaningful; post-2032 patent defense remains partly unresolved.

incremental_roic_and_fcf_per_share.reason: Strong operating leverage and low physical capex, offset by pending KRW553B upfront and working-capital needs.

management_and_capital_allocation.reason: Excellent XCOPRI execution, but management agreed to a large Opakalim deal despite known rodent toxicity; deferring close/payment after the hold is a positive control.

financial_survivability.reason: Pre-close cash-generative and bank-debt-free; closing would require borrowing.

expectation_gap_and_valuation.reason: Price reset helps, but ~27x owner cash and mid-teens reverse growth requirement are not obviously cheap given the patent cliff.

power_law_and_asymmetry.reason: Successful Opakalim plus existing U.S. infrastructure has large upside; failure plus patent cliff creates large downside.

items.resolution_needed: Escalate on material accounting/control or disclosure failure.
Need hold resolution, RISE3 data, final financing/closing terms and risk-adjusted return evidence.
Monitor remaining generic litigation and settlement launch timing.
Escalate if XCOPRI slows materially or Opakalim fails while valuation stays high.
Need a de-risked second commercial product or materially stronger diversification before patent cliff.
Escalate if acquisition capital is sunk while core XCOPRI economics weaken.

valuation.reverse_expectations: 10%/18x requires ~14.5% 10y owner-cash/share CAGR; diagnostic smooths over 2032 patent cliff.

attacks: 98.5% H1 revenue concentration in cenobamate makes the earnings base vulnerable to one product shock.
U.S. gross-to-net economics require large rebate/discount/return estimates; provision liabilities are rising.
XCOPRI compound patent expires in 2032; one generic settlement grants confidential future launch rights and two disputes remain.
Opakalim upfront is ~46% of FY2025 assets and requires borrowing.
Management knew of the rodent toxicity signal before signing; FDA later imposed a partial clinical hold.
RISE3 remains unread; open-label 54% responder data do not substitute for randomized pivotal efficacy.
External appraisal uses 71.9% success, 2029 launch and high long-run margins—valuation assumptions, not facts.
RPT/TPD pipeline is mostly early stage and deserves little base-case value today.
H1 operating cash conversion required large receivable/prepaid working-capital investment.
At ~27x normalized owner cash, the stock still prices substantial compounding despite patent and second-product uncertainty.
red_team.strongest_bear_thesis: XCOPRI grows for several years but normalizes before 2032; generic entry erodes the franchise; Opakalim fails or arrives too late after substantial capital is committed; early pipeline cannot replace cash flow.
red_team.independence: Same analyst/model performed red-team; not independent.

falsifiers: XCOPRI U.S. sales growth <15% YoY for two consecutive quarters with TRx/NBRx stagnation.
Gross-to-net provisions outgrow U.S. product sales for multiple quarters.
Opakalim hold persists beyond 1Q 2027 or a human safety signal emerges.
RISE3 misses primary endpoint or shows material safety/tolerability problems.
Management closes Opakalim on unchanged economics after materially worse evidence without added risk sharing.
Generic entry becomes likely near 2032 with no replacement product.
Normalized owner cash/share fails to grow ~10% cumulatively over two years despite revenue growth.
increase_evidence: Partial hold lifted without meaningful human-safety concern.
RISE3 shows statistically and clinically compelling efficacy with differentiated tolerability.
XCOPRI maintains >20% organic U.S. growth into 2027 with healthy TRx/NBRx.
Patent outcomes preserve meaningful exclusivity beyond 2032.
Normalized owner cash reaches ~KRW300B+ with clean cash conversion.
Second-product launch path is visible before the patent cliff.
Price around/below ~KRW65,000 creates ~25% margin to Base, but price alone is insufficient while vetoes remain open.
sell_evidence: Structural XCOPRI prescription slowdown, payer pressure or new safety signal.
Generic entry likely close to 2032 with no replacement product.
Opakalim hold persists or pivotal efficacy fails after significant capital commitment.
Large debt-funded acquisitions continue without high risk-adjusted return evidence.
Owner cash/share structurally declines while R&D/acquisition spending rises.

source_quality.primary: User-supplied DART filings plus SKBP/Biohaven primary releases.
source_quality.secondary: Independent post-filing news and current market price.
source_quality.limitations: RISE3 topline not yet reported; hold/closing status fast-moving; settlement terms confidential.
